name: Fantastic Frontier
desc:
Fantastic Frontier's Spring Update [v1.3] arrives! Featuring a huge new island to explore and collect from, with new weapons and armor, 2 new houses, a new task-giver, long requested balance changes and more!
To get to the Island purchase the new Boathouse, just south of the Blue Ogre Camp.

Check the Official groups for the exact balance changes this patch.

----

Official Group: www.roblox.com/groups/group.aspx?gid=3352883

Fantastic Frontier is an action adventure game where you can fight monsters, fish, gather rare collectibles, hunt birds and more! Loot you find can be used to upgrade your character, buy a home and become a legendary hero! 

🐭 If you'd like to support us please like and favorite the game! 🐸
